# himmel

> A harness that runs Claude Code as a managed, PR-gated, overnight-capable agent: hooks, git gates and guardrails enforce the workflow at the tool-call layer instead of asking the model to remember prose. Memory is durable, hand-editable markdown — handover files plus an optional companion vault — not a vector DB.

Working **inside** this repo? Read [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) first — it is the authoritative rule set and loads into every session. Just **pointed at** this repo to set it up? Start at Install. Everything below is a router: open the linked file rather than re-deriving from code.

## Install

himmel is a harness *for* [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) — install that first. The wizard checks the prerequisites (`git`, `bash` 3.2+, `node`, `jq`, `python3`; `gh` and `bun` optional) and fails fast with hints.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yotamleo/himmel
node himmel/scripts/himmelctl/bin.js install --scope project   # or --scope user
# node-less machine? run first: bash himmel/scripts/himmelctl/bootstrap.sh
```

Four independent axes, each named exactly once here:

- **Scope** — `project` wires the target repo's `.claude/settings.json` (commit it and everyone who clones the repo gets the harness); `user` wires `~/.claude/settings.json` (you, in every project on this machine). Change it later with `himmelctl scope set <project|user>`.
- **Install profile** — `core` (hooks, git gates, worktree workflow, marketplace plugins), `luna` (companion-vault scaffold), or `all`. Item membership is data: `scripts/install/manifest.json`.
- **Saved install-profile file** — a `*.install-profile.json` preset of every wizard answer, including the release channel. `--scope` loads a shipped adopter one; `--from-profile <file>` loads your own. Detail: [docs/setup/profiles/README.md](docs/setup/profiles/README.md).
- **Release channel** — `stable` (highest `vX.Y.Z` tag) or `pre` (prereleases too), read from `HIMMEL_UPDATE_CHANNEL` or the saved install-profile file's `channel`; neither set means a plain `git pull`. Detail: [docs/setup/updating.md](docs/setup/updating.md).

A fifth, unrelated axis: the **plugin profile** — `lean` vs `full` marketplace plugin sets, toggled with `/profile`, registry at `scripts/lanes/plugin-profiles.json`.

Full walkthrough plus the adaptation checklist for a non-himmel repo: [docs/setup/install.md](docs/setup/install.md). Coming from an older himmel install: [docs/setup/migrating.md](docs/setup/migrating.md).

## Lifecycle verbs

- `/himmel-doctor` — read-only, severity-grouped health report; `--fix` repairs the node wiring.
- `/himmel-update` — harness `git pull` plus a marketplace re-sync. Claude Code's `autoUpdate` does **not** deliver himmel.
- `node scripts/himmelctl/bin.js ensure` — reconcile a drifted install against the manifest, per item, with severities.
- `node scripts/himmelctl/bin.js uninstall` — symmetric offboarding, both scopes.
- `/luna-upgrade` — upgrade a companion vault to the current template.

All four lifecycle paths: [docs/setup/updating.md](docs/setup/updating.md).

## Enforcement

Structural, not prose: Claude Code PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks plus `pre-commit` / `commit-msg` / `pre-push` git gates. **Do not read an enumerated hook list from any document — it drifts.** The live inventory is `.claude/settings.json` and `.pre-commit-config.yaml`; the classification of every gate as HARD / auth-gated / advisory, plus each layer's off-switch, is [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md). Bypasses are session env vars set in the *launching* shell, never a per-call prefix.

Data egress from graph extraction is fenced by one policy file, `scripts/guardrails/egress-matrix.json`.
